page.layout: One block of text in a single column, with headings centred in the column. Running head at top centre above the text. Page number at top right. Signature line at the foot: "(***) 2" left of centre and catchword "Barones" at the right.

main_text.head: Landgravii, qui non sunt Principes, sed in Comitum dignitate.
main_text.l: Burgendie Landgravius, seu Burgundie Helvetice, in Burgenden.
main_text.head: Burggravii, qui non sunt Principes, sed in Comitum dignitate.
main_text.l: Kirckberge Burggravius in Thuringia: qui nunc vivit, est ultimus suae stirpis, & improlis.

page.notes: Printed in italic type with roman and black letter words mixed in; the German words "in der Baar" and "in Burgenden" are in black letter. Some letters in the lower part of the page are faint. The "Z" in "Zollerani" and "Hohenzollerani" is a decorative form. Ink spots on the page are not text.
